method.fps: sum(counter delta) / sum(actual sampleWindowMs); same attempt, generation, peerEpoch, sampleId and equal RTC/display time boundaries
method.foreground: complete sample inside active scene interval after first GPU completion
method.normalSupply: foreground sample with decode FPS >= 50, matching previous baseline method
method.quantiles: nearest rank; per-frame GPU timings and rolling drawable snapshot quantiles are reported separately
method.gpuGap: sort by actual presentedAtMonotonicMs, independent of delayed MainActor trace delivery
method.ingressTimingBoundary: timings observe accepted latest frames; coalesced discarded frames have no individual queue-age sample
method.drawableBoundary: drawable FPS uses aligned health deltas; per-drawable timestamps remain sampled cumulative distributions
